description: Returns the result of one published battle, by pair id or by its two brand names: the two products compared, the consensus choice share of the first product with its confidence interval, the headline claims (which product the panel leans to, or too close to call when the interval includes 50%), how many API models leaned each way, the panel and the conditions. A battle compares two products, not the brands overall. When two names match more than one battle, the call is refused with the candidate pair ids; call again with one pair_id. Includes the signed snapshot hash and URL for verification. Read-only.

brand_a.description: A brand name as shown on the board, e.g. Michelin.

brand_b.description: A brand name as shown on the board, e.g. Michelin.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.

name: battle_result

claims.description: Headline claims of the claims engine: a stable code, its parameters and the only number renderings it allows.

models.description: The API models of the panel (display id without the version date; the dated id is in model_id and the snapshot).

title: Battle result
